subject: Procurement & budget owner mapping - ACME
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Sanders <emily.sanders@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-03T14:05:00Z
Subject: Post-demo recap & procurement next steps

Hi Emily -

Great speaking with you and Jordan earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned:

Summary from call:
- Redwood hosted API fits your latency/throughput needs; Dedicated pool discussed for predictable throughput.
- Primary use case: customer-facing search/reranking and embeddings at scale.
- Key procurement questions: PO vs card, internal marketplace ordering, and signatory path.

Action items we agreed on:
1) Can you confirm whether ACME will purchase via PO or corporate card?
2) Please share the procurement contact (name + email) and the expected approvers (finance sponsor, legal signatory).
3) Let us know if you prefer a marketplace listing (e.g., AWS Marketplace) or direct contract.

If helpful, I can send a short quote and a procurement questionnaire for your team / procurement to review.

Proposed next step: I'll put together a 1-page quote + questionnaire and loop in procurement if you're ready.

Thanks - appreciated the time.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

From: Emily Sanders <emily.sanders@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Hayes <j.hayes@acme-corp.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-06-04T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & procurement next steps

Hi Marissa -

Thanks for the recap. Quick answers from procurement side:

- Purchase method: We prefer PO for enterprise deals > $50k; for small pilots we may use corporate card. This will be a PO.
- Procurement contact: Jordan Hayes (j.hayes@acme-corp.com) is the procurement lead for our AI/ML platform purchases - I've cc'd him.
- Approvals: Finance sponsor is Priya N. (Priya Natarajan, vp-finance@acme-corp.com). Legal signatory is the Head of Legal; procurement will route final contract.
- Marketplace: We are open to AWS Marketplace for ease of billing, but legal still prefers a direct MSA for the first purchase.

Please go ahead and send the quote and procurement questionnaire. Jordan / procurement will need the following to start a PO: catalog item or SKU, total contract value (annual), billing frequency, and contact to send the invoice to.

Emily
Director, Product Operations | ACME Corp
emily.sanders@acme-corp.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Hayes <j.hayes@acme-corp.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Cc: Emily Sanders <emily.sanders@acme-corp.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-05T16:40:00Z
Subject: Quote + procurement questionnaire (ACME)

Hi Jordan / procurement team -

Thanks Emily. Attaching a short quote and a procurement questionnaire to help your PO process. Highlights:
- SKU: RW-DEDICATED-1Y
- Term: 12 months
- Annual list: $120,000 (we typically offer a 15% first-year onboarding credit for pilots; let me know if that's relevant)
- Billing: Net 30 via invoice to accounts-payable@acme-corp.com, or marketplace monthly billing if you choose AWS Marketplace.

Attachment stub:
- redwood-quote-ACME-20260607.pdf (quote + payment instructions)
- procurement-questionnaire-ACME.pdf (SOC2, data retention, network/ISP requirements)

Next steps requested from your side:
1) Confirm PO path and provide the expected PO requisition number once raised.
2) Introduce the finance sponsor (Priya) or share contact so we can include them on the invoice template.
3) Confirm whether ACME wants Redwood on AWS Marketplace or direct MSA - if marketplace, we can provide the listing SKU to include on the PO.

If helpful, we can also provide a one-page MSA summary for your legal team to speed review.

Best,
Marissa

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-07T09:15:00Z
Subject: RE: Quote + procurement questionnaire (ACME)

Marissa - quick internal note on approvals mapping for ACME:

- Economic buyer: Emily (Product Ops) seems to own budget allocation for the initiative, but finance sponsor is Priya (VP Finance) for PO approvals.
- Procurement process: PO preferred; procurement lead Jordan will push through requisition. Expect Net 30 terms; confirm if AP requires encoded invoice lines (we can provide sample).
- Marketplace vs direct: Legal prefers direct MSA initially; marketplace later for renewals. Recommend we include both options on the quote (marketplace SKU + direct invoice details).
- Signatory path: ACME legal signatory for this tier is 'Head of Legal' - ask Jordan for the specific person to route DocuSign correctly.

Suggest the next outbound: send final quote with both payment options + a short one-pager MSA summary and request PO number + finance sponsor contact. I can review pricing tweaks if needed before sending.

Vivek
Director, Enterprise Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
